'''April 2001 Madrid tournament (21 April, first event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 21 April 2001. [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-ithor-madrid-04-21-01d2133/ ithor-madrid-04-21-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 23 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-ithor-madrid-04-21-01d2133/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]]
